description: A delegated document-work mandate for an agent that takes a legal matter from draft to docket. The chain runs document_drafted -> citations_checked -> document_filed -> docket_confirmed (cite-check and docket are optional; draft and file are required). doc_type is confined to allowed_doc_types on both the draft and the filing, and court is confined to allowed_courts on both the filing and the docket confirmation, so a filing of an unpermitted document type, or in a court off the allowlist, is nonconformant. The chain is bound end to end (evidence_bindings): the citation check and the filing must carry the SAME document_hash and matter_ref that were drafted (you cannot draft one document and file a different one), and the docket confirmation must carry the SAME matter_ref and court as the filing. Evidence is closed (additionalProperties:false). Privilege-safe by construction: the document text, the matter reference, the working title, and the cite-check findings are sealed only as sha256 hashes; only closed-vocabulary or public values (doc_type, court, docket number, authorities-checked count) are sealed in the clear. The verifier enforces the shape, the allowlists, and the bindings — not the meaning of the hashed references.
